posts.title: Past and Future
posts.description: I’ve been reading AskAManager a lot, lately. Kind of odd for someone who doesn’t work outside the home, but I’m enjoying it. I ran into this, published in 2013. Mentioning 2026 had me chuckling. Also crying, but. Oh well. I love your blog, but how long are these answers accessible for? posts.title: Taken two weeks apart, around the same time in the morning. The sunrise hits down by the main road…
posts.description: Taken two weeks apart, around the same time in the morning. The sunrise hits down by the main road first, and lights up a sycamore’s fall color as if it were on fire. The same scene in a fog looks like a different planet.
